title: I Returned the Expired Bike-Tune Hold Ticket With the Promise Date Circled

parts.text: I picked up the hold ticket at 4:16 p.m. and the promise date had been Tuesday. Today was Friday and my numbered fork still sat in the back. I was thirty, courier, holding a slip that said READY BY CLOSE. Desk lead Mara shrugged. "Shop time is shop time." I photographed the ticket, the circled Tuesday, and the fork still on the stand. Then I asked for the hold log. At 4:24 the owner pinged why my fork was still billed as ready. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Mara wrote a new line: PROMISE DATES ARE DATES. I keep the circled copy in my bag.

social.video_title: The bike shop billed ready and kept my fork — Part 1/1
social.description: Tuesday promise, Friday fork, a circled hold ticket. Would you have asked for the hold log?
